**No Iranian strike on Jordan since 8–9 Sep (Muwaffaq Salti); Jordanian national among the 12 killed at Riyadh's airport (10 Oct).** King Abdullah attended the 22-Sep Trump–GCC meeting. — absence REPORTED.

**At the Germany chiefs' meeting (Axios). No Iranian ballistic launch at a host state for 7 days (longest pause since 28 Aug) — the Muwaffaq Salti salvos of 9 Sep were the last.** — CONFIRMED non-event.

Jordan absorbed two Iranian ballistic salvos aimed at US bases: 1 Sep (Camp Titin/Prince Hassan AB; 10 of 13 intercepted, rest on open ground) and 9 Sep (18 of 20 intercepted; CBS: an A-10 lost a wing and ~8 F-15s lightly damaged at Muwaffaq Salti AB; no casualties reported). Iran claims US dead — CLAIMED. (Al Jazeera, Reuters/Jordan MoD, CBS — CONFIRMED interceptions; REPORTED aircraft damage)

Hit for a SECOND consecutive day -- ballistic missiles at the Al-Azraq base; Jordan said it intercepted 20 missiles with 'no casualties or material damage.' Confined itself to interception statements -- no expulsion, no escalation. The iran->jordan edge bumped on the second confirmed strike.

**JORDAN STRUCK BY IRAN FOR THE FIRST TIME — AZRAQ AIRBASE HIT BY LONG-RANGE MISSILES, ALL FIVE INTERCEPTED, ZERO CASUALTIES.** Early Wednesday the IRGC fired long-range missiles at Azraq airbase in Jordan (alongside Bahrain's Fifth Fleet HQ and Kuwait's Ali Al Salem) — the first Iranian strike on Jordanian soil this war, widening the target geography beyond the Gulf to a Levant US ally. Jordan's military said it intercepted all five missiles (shrapnel only, 'no human injuries or material damage'); the IRGC claimed it destroyed an F-35 hangar at Azraq — DENIED. Third iteration of the spectacular-claims/intercepted/zero-casualty pattern. Arab League condemned the 'brutal' attacks and declared 'full solidarity'; no expulsions or downgrades — words, not actions. (CONFIRMED interception — Jordanian military statement; Al Jazeera; CNN/Reuters/NBC pool. CLAIMED damage — Tasnim/IRGC, denied.) (intel A5)

recent_signals.headline: JORDAN INTERCEPTED 8 IRANIAN MISSILES (9 JUL) IN THE MULTI-STATE RETALIATION WAVE — FIRST TIME IN THIS PHASE JORDAN WAS TARGETED; NO DAMAGE/CASUALTIES REPORTED; AMMAN POSTURE: INTERCEPT + CONDEMN, NO COUNTER-ESCALATION (consistent with the Gulf pattern)

**JORDAN IS NOW THE WAR'S DEADLIEST VECTOR FOR THE US.** Muwaffaq Salti air base at Al-Azraq struck by Iranian ballistic missiles and drones on the night of 17 Jul: two US service members killed, one missing, four medevaced to Jordanian hospitals. On 19 Jul Iran fired again toward AQABA — US air defences intercepted, the Jordanian military reported three missiles downed and a fourth hitting open ground with no injuries, while the IDF fired Iron Dome at fragments threatening Eilat. Separately the US Embassy in Amman issued a 19 Jul security alert telling Americans to avoid Aqaba's airport and seaport, saying Jordanian authorities had EVACUATED both over a 'specific and credible threat' — **Jordan publicly CONTRADICTED this**, with government spokesman Mohammad al-Momani telling Petra that no evacuation orders were issued and both facilities were operating normally. Nothing was struck. The documented government-to-government contradiction is what makes this intelligence rather than noise. First indication that Aqaba — a NON-HORMUZ route — may be entering the target set. CONFIRMED (attack) / REPORTED (Aqaba threat).

**JORDAN PUBLICLY CONTRADICTED THE IRGC'S AQABA DAMAGE CLAIM — the second such contradiction in three days.** The IRGC stated 20 July via IRIB that it had launched **ballistic missiles at US C-17 transport and P-8 maritime patrol aircraft at Aqaba airport**, claiming several heavily damaged, and that **20 hangars housing US forces at Muwaffaq Salti, Azraq, were destroyed** — CLAIMED, one side only. **Jordan's account is flatly incompatible:** on 21 July the Jordanian military, via the official **Petra** agency, announced that **five Iranian drones aimed at the kingdom were 'neutralized efficiently and accurately'** and that **'the operation did not result in any casualties or material damage.'** Note also the divergence in weapon type — IRGC says ballistic missiles, Jordan says drones. **ASSESSMENT: an Iranian attack on Jordan occurred and was defeated; the threatened Aqaba strike did NOT happen in any confirmable form.** This follows the 19 July episode in which the US Embassy in Amman warned of a 'specific and credible threat' to Aqaba and **Jordan publicly denied any evacuation.** **Treat ALL Aqaba reporting with structural scepticism.** Jordan remains the war's deadliest vector for the US (2 killed, 1 missing at Al-Azraq) and, because Aqaba and Eilat are adjacent, **every Iranian salvo at Aqaba is a near-miss on Israel — now the likeliest accidental route into Israeli belligerence, more so than Lebanon.** CONFIRMED (Jordanian military) / CLAIMED (IRGC damage).
